components.css: .ds-theme{display:block;width:142px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-family:"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;}.ds-theme span{float:right}.ds-theme input{appearance:none;display:block;width:100%;height:24px;border-radius:20px;margin:6px 0 0;background:var(--wash);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}.ds-theme input::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--paper)}.ds-theme input::-moz-range-thumb{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--paper)}.ds-theme input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:2px;}.ds-theme input{transition:background-color 360ms ease}.ds-theme input::-webkit-slider-thumb{transition:transform 360ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a quiet, personal page built around readable paragraphs, restrained navigation, and existing photographs and project images. Helvetica Neue supplies a consistent voice across headings, writing, and controls. The owner’s chosen gray is the default background.

This system describes the implemented home, project index and details, interactive systems gallery, and command center. The timeline implementation is parked for future use, with no visible page reference. The archived desktop at `/archive` remains a separate legacy surface. `/machines` redirects to `/systems`, which contains ATmega128, a movable cube, chronograph, planetary gearbox, maglev train, capacitor, Raptor engine, and GPU studies.
keyCharacteristics: A centered column with generous vertical space.
Neutral backgrounds, subdued secondary text, and small orange accents.
Flat rows and original imagery instead of decorative containers.
Compact navigation, a searchable command center, and a shared four-stop appearance slider.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Use orange for interaction and small identifying details, as in the existing links and focus rings.

rules.name: The Four Backgrounds Rule
rules.body: Offer gray, black, white, and cream, retaining gray as the initial background.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Retain Helvetica Neue throughout the redesigned portfolio and keep font switching out of its controls.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use lines and tonal selection states for the portfolio's page and control structure.

dos: **Do** keep the centered reading column and Helvetica Neue.
**Do** preserve the original portrait, experience logos, and supplied project images.
**Do** use active theme roles for text, dividers, selected states, and focus.
**Do** preserve keyboard navigation, visible focus, reduced-motion handling, and drag selection.
donts: **Don't** add mountain scenery, background patterns, or font switching to the redesigned portfolio.
**Don't** pass generated imagery or unlabeled sample data off as actual project evidence.
**Don't** promote archive styling or diagram-specific shading into ordinary portfolio page chrome.
